To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Pt-doped and Pt-SnO2-templating TiO2 are very active in the CO oxidation reaction.

the presence of Pt in the TiO 2 lattice, and the presence of SnO 2 in the lattice or on the surface of TiO 2, both promote the oxidation of CO by O 2, especially at low pCO and high O ₂:CO ratios, and that the presence of Sn on the surface of Pt-doped TiO 2 has no effect on its activity.
the Pt-doped and the SnO 2 templated TiO 1.0 can be prepared by a sol-gel method, and are very active for CO oxidation, especially at low pCO and high O2:CO ratios.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and characterisation of a series of Pt-doped and Pt-SnO 2 -doped titania catalysts, their activity in CO oxidation and their reactivity in CO-O 2 mixtures.
the preparation, characterisation and reactivity of Pt-doped TiO2 and Pt-doped SnO2- templated TiO2.
the preparation of TiO 2 -based materials with high activity for CO oxidation and the elucidation of the mechanism of this reaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Pt-doped and/or SnO 2-templated titania can be very effective in CO oxidation at low p CO, high O 2 concentrations and moderate to high temperatures.
the presence of Pt in the TiO 2 lattice and of SnO 2 in TiO 2 is beneficial for the oxidation of CO by O 2, especially at low temperatures and low p CO.
Pt is a good promoter of CO oxidation over TiO2 and that SnO2-templates may also be beneficial.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Pt-doped TiO 2 is active in CO oxidation at temperatures of reaction below 200°C and that the addition of SnO 2 to Pt-doped Ti O 2 is a means to improve the activity at temperatures above 200°C.
the Pt-oxide interaction, the Pt particle size and the presence of a template are the most important variables in the preparation and activity of these materials.
Pt is a very good catalyst for CO oxidation at low p CO but that the presence of SnO 2 and water vapour is necessary for it to be active at high p CO.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SnO2- templated Pt/TiO2 catalyst is a promising material for CO removal from the exhaust of diesel engines, and the catalyst can be prepared in a simple manner.
Pt-doped and Pt-SnO2-templating TiO2 can be prepared with very high specific area, and that they are very active for CO oxidation.
the Pt-TiO2 system is very active in CO-oxidation at low p CO, high O2:CO ratios and low temperatures.
